entries.reason: How the people fared: how much of the need that waiting would leave above the threshold the scored people were spared, as a share of what their own routine spares them on the same seed. U is the need above the threshold summed over the scored people's person-minutes, read from every minute's state, and the term is (U of waiting minus U of this run) over (U of waiting minus U of the routine). Waiting scores 0 and the routine 1 by construction; a run can score below 0 or above 1, and every reader shows the value unclipped. The threshold is the need at which the recorded routine prefers an activity to every other, read from the routine the run's input records. It is the only weighed term, and it reads states alone: no answer, answer time, receipt or disposition reaches it. Where everybody outside the group follows their routine, as a judged comparison requires, a model that answers no turn scores exactly what the routine scores, because the routine decides every turn it leaves; where a model decides for somebody outside the group, it is asked in every arm, the anchors included, and its answers move the anchors too. What each model answered is reported beside it, never in it. Only relief from need counts: in the routine's own catalog resting relieves need and visiting a little, while standing and talking relieve none, so either one while rested neither earns nor costs, and every minute a person spends above the threshold costs its excess, whatever they do.

entries.reason: The scored people's turns whose choice the minute applied: the model decided them. Read from the decision_applied events the engine appends, by disposition. Each reliability count is reported beside the score in two forms, never weighed: as a share of the run's own turns, and per choice point the routine had for the same people on the same seed, a count recorded by the routine's own run before any model run of that seed starts. Where everybody outside the group follows their routine, as a judged comparison requires, that run asks nobody, so no model's answers move the count.
